bio.text: Gary Swing is the Green Party candidate for Arizona's 6th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the party's July 21 primary as a write-in candidate.
Swing was born in Willingboro, New Jersey, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Colorado Boulder in 1991 and a master's degree from the University of Colorado Denver in 1999.
Swing's career experience includes working as a caregiver and neighborhood business association promoter, and Swing has served as spokesperson for Best Democracy.
